Gold.note: Central bank buying and rate cut expectations support elevated prices despite high spot levels.

Silver.note: Industrial demand weakness and recent underperformance versus gold cap upside.

Copper.note: Tight concentrate markets and green energy demand offset by a sluggish Chinese property sector.

Uranium.note: Structural supply deficit and strong utility contracting underpin the ongoing nuclear renaissance.

Lithium.note: Persistent oversupply and slowing EV battery demand growth weigh heavily on market sentiment.

Nickel.note: Surging Indonesian supply and shifting battery chemistry preferences create a bearish outlook.

Zinc.note: Tight treatment charges and mine supply constraints support prices despite mixed smelting margins.

Iron Ore.note: Weak Chinese steel margins and ongoing property sector headwinds continue to suppress demand.

Coal.note: Thermal coal demand faces structural headwinds while metallurgical coal remains relatively stable.

Rare Earths.note: Opaque pricing and geopolitical trade tensions balance out strong long-term EV motor demand.

Manganese.note: Steady steel alloy demand with no major supply disruptions or demand catalysts expected.

PGM.note: Declining internal combustion engine sales are currently offset by emerging hydrogen economy potential.

Potash.note: Global agricultural demand remains stable as global supply chains fully normalize post-geopolitical shocks.

Aluminum.note: Capacity curtailments in China and robust lightweighting demand support a bullish medium-term view.

Diversified.note: Broad multi-commodity exposure balances specific sector risks, resulting in a neutral macro outlook.
